Services

Orly, Charles de Gaulle, Beauvais. Flight tracking and a name sign waiting for you at arrivals.

Paris & Eiffel Tower

Eiffel Tower, Champs-Élysées, the Louvre, a Seine cruise, the palace hotels of Avenue George V and Avenue Montaigne: I drop you in the heart of Paris and pick you up again.

FAQ

      
Good to know

    

    
What if my flight is delayed?
I track your flight in real time and adjust my arrival. Waiting caused by a delay is never charged.

    
How many passengers can you take?
Up to 4 passengers and 3 medium-sized suitcases, in my hybrid Toyota Corolla Touring Sports.

    
Do you work outside Versailles?
Yes, anywhere in the Paris region: Paris and the 7 other départements. Longer trips are quoted on request.

    
Can you pick me up at my hotel?
Yes, I pick you up directly at your hotel, including Paris palace hotels such as the Four Seasons George V, the Plaza Athénée, The Peninsula or the Shangri-La.

    
Can I book at the last minute?
Yes, subject to availability. Call directly for a pickup within two hours.

    
Is there a minimum fare?
Yes, every ride costs at least €20, for example a trip within Versailles.

    
How do I pay?
By card on board, cash, or bank transfer for companies. The price quoted is the price you pay.
